items.followUp: How can eating too much saturated fat affect the heart and blood vessels?

rubric.why: Excess saturated fat can raise cholesterol in the blood.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that too much saturated fat raises blood cholesterol.

rubric.why: Raised cholesterol increases the risk of cardiovascular disease.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming blocked arteries or coronary heart disease as a health risk.

modelAnswer: Eating too much saturated fatty acid raises blood cholesterol.
This increases the risk of blocked arteries and coronary heart disease.
